column1: # mapping_set_title: CDIF core+discovery to ESIP Science-on-Schema.org
# mapping_set_description: Property correspondences applied by ConvertToSOSO.py (CDIF core+discovery -> SOSO v1.3).
#   Structural transforms the converter performs that are not term-to-term
#   mappings (so they have no TSV row):
#   - schema:subjectOf catalog record (with dcterms:conformsTo) is dropped - SOSO has no metadata-conformance mechanism.
#   - @context rewritten to SOSO style ({@vocab: http://schema.org/}); schema: prefixes stripped from property names and @type.
#   - Warnings emitted (not mappings) for SOSO-required fields the CDIF record lacks: description, version, url, license.

column8: schema: prefix stripped; SOSO serializes bare via @vocab http://schema.org/
CDIF-only; passed through open-world (not a SOSO term)
